meaning: Father of Oholiab, a skilled artisan for the tabernacle
notes: Ahisamach, from the tribe of Dan, was the father of Oholiab, a skilled artisan who helped construct the tabernacle.

name: Ahishahar
meaning: Son of Bilhan, a Benjamite
notes: Ahishahar was a son of Bilhan and a descendant of Benjamin.

name: Ahishar
meaning: In charge of Solomon's palace
notes: Ahishar was in charge of King Solomon's palace.

name: Ahithophel
meaning: David's counselor who joined Absalom's rebellion, later committed suicide
notes: Ahithophel was a wise counselor to David who defected to Absalom's side during Absalom's rebellion, but later committed suicide when his advice was not followed.

name: Ahitub
meaning: Ancestor of Ezra the scribe, in the priestly line
notes: Ahitub, son of Amariah and father of Zadok, was an ancestor of Ezra the scribe in the priestly line.

name: Ahitub
meaning: Father of Ahimelech, High Priest at Nob killed by Saul
notes: Ahitub was the father of Ahimelech, the High Priest at Nob who was killed by Saul for aiding David.

name: Ahitub
meaning: Father of Zadok the priest during David's reign
notes: Ahitub was the father of Zadok, who served as a priest alongside Abiathar during the reign of King David.

name: Ahlai
meaning: Father of Zabad, one of David's mighty men
notes: Ahlai was the father of Zabad, who was one of David's mighty men.

name: Ahlai
meaning: Daughter of Sheshan, a Jerahmeelite
notes: Ahlai was the daughter of Sheshan, a descendant of Jerahmeel, from the tribe of Judah.

name: Ahoah
meaning: Descendant of Benjamin, clan of David's mighty men
notes: The Ahohites, descendants of Ahoah of Benjamin, were a clan that included some of David's mighty men, such as Eleazar and Zalmon.

name: Ahumai
meaning: Descendant of Judah through Reaiah
notes: Ahumai was a descendant of Judah through his grandson Reaiah.

name: Ahuzzam
meaning: Son of Ashhur and Naarah, a Judahite
notes: Ahuzzam was the son of Ashhur and his wife Naarah, from the tribe of Judah.

name: Ahuzzath
meaning: Friend and advisor of Abimelech, Philistine king of Gerar
notes: Ahuzzath was a friend and advisor of Abimelech, the Philistine king of Gerar, who accompanied him when making a treaty with Isaac.

name: Aiah
meaning: Father of Rizpah, Saul's concubine
notes: Aiah was the father of Rizpah, who was a concubine of King Saul.

name: Aiah
meaning: Son of Zibeon the Hivite, brother of Anah
notes: Aiah was the son of Zibeon the Hivite and the brother of Anah, who was a descendant of Esau.

name: Akan
meaning: Son of Ezer, a Horite chief in Seir
notes: Akan was the son of Ezer, a Horite chief who lived in the land of Seir.

name: Akkub
meaning: Descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah
notes: Akkub was a descendant of King Jehoiachin of Judah, listed in the genealogy of the royal line.

name: Akkub
meaning: Levite gatekeeper during the post-exilic period
notes: Akkub was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper in the Temple during the post-exilic period.

name: Akkub
meaning: Family head of Temple servants who returned from exile
notes: Akkub was a family head of the Temple servants (Nethinim) who returned to Jerusalem from the Babylonian exile.

name: Akkub
meaning: Levite who helped explain the Law to the people
notes: Akkub was a Levite who assisted Ezra in explaining the Law to the people during the public reading.

name: Alemeth
meaning: Son of Becher, a Benjamite
notes: Alemeth was a son of Becher and a descendant of Benjamin.

name: Alemeth
meaning: Son of Jehoaddah, a Benjamite from Gibeon
notes: Alemeth was a son of Jehoaddah (or 'Jehoadah'), a Benjamite from Gibeon, and is listed in the genealogies of Saul's family.

name: Alexander
meaning: Opponent of Paul, along with Hymenaeus
notes: Alexander, along with Hymenaeus, was an opponent of Paul's teaching and was handed over to Satan by Paul.

name: Alexander
meaning: Jew put forward by the crowd in Ephesus
notes: Alexander was a Jew whom the crowd put forward during the riot in Ephesus, but they shouted him down when they realized he was a Jew.

name: Alexander
meaning: Member of the high-priestly family in Jerusalem
notes: Alexander was a member of the high-priestly family in Jerusalem who was present during Peter and John's interrogation before the Sanhedrin.

name: Alexander
meaning: Son of Simon who carried the cross
notes: Alexander was the son of Simon of Cyrene, who was compelled to carry Jesus' cross.

name: Allon
meaning: Son of Jedaiah, a Simeonite
notes: Allon was the son of Jedaiah, a descendant of Simeon.

name: Almodad
meaning: Son of Joktan, descendant of Shem
notes: Almodad was a son of Joktan and a descendant of Shem, listed in the genealogies of the nations.

name: Alphaeus
meaning: Father of apostles James and Matthew (Levi)
notes: Alphaeus was the father of two of Jesus' apostles, James and Matthew (also known as Levi).

name: Alvah
meaning: Edomite chief, descendant of Esau
notes: Alvah was an Edomite chief, a descendant of Esau through his son Eliphaz.

name: Alvan
meaning: Horite chief, descendant of Seir
notes: Alvan was a Horite chief, a descendant of Seir, who lived in the land of Edom before Esau's descendants.

name: Amal
meaning: Son of Helem, an Asherite
notes: Amal was a son of Helem, a descendant of Asher, and is listed in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

name: Amalek
meaning: Grandson of Esau, ancestor of the Amalekites
notes: Amalek was the son of Eliphaz and grandson of Esau, and he became the ancestor of the Amalekite people.

name: Amariah
meaning: Levite, descendant of Hebron, during David's reign
notes: Amariah was a Levite, a descendant of Hebron, who served during the reign of King David.

name: Amariah
meaning: High priest, ancestor of Ezra the scribe
notes: Amariah was a high priest during the reign of Jehoshaphat and an ancestor of Ezra the scribe.

name: Amariah
meaning: Ancestor of Zadok the priest, in Aaron's line
notes: Amariah, son of Meraioth, was an ancestor of Zadok the priest and a descendant of Aaron through his son Eleazar.

name: Amariah
meaning: Chief priest under King Jehoshaphat of Judah
notes: Amariah was the chief priest who assisted King Jehoshaphat in his judicial reforms in Judah.

name: Amariah
meaning: Levite during the reign of King Hezekiah
notes: Amariah was a Levite who served during the reign of King Hezekiah and assisted in distributing offerings to his fellow Levites.

name: Amariah
meaning: Israelite who agreed to put away his foreign wife
notes: Amariah was one of the Israelites who had married a foreign woman and agreed to put her away during Ezra's reforms.

name: Amariah
meaning: Priest who sealed Nehemiah's covenant and served as chief priest
notes: Amariah was a priest who sealed Nehemiah's covenant and later served as a chief priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim.

name: Amariah
meaning: Judahite who resettled in Jerusalem
notes: Amariah, a descendant of Judah through Perez, was among those chosen to resettle in Jerusalem during Nehemiah's time.

name: Amariah
meaning: Ancestor of Zephaniah the prophet
notes: Amariah was an ancestor of Zephaniah the prophet, who prophesied during the reign of King Josiah of Judah.

name: Amasa
meaning: Ephraimite leader who opposed enslaving Judahite captives
notes: Amasa, along with other leaders of Ephraim, opposed the Israelite army's attempt to bring Judahite captives as slaves to Samaria.

name: Amasa
meaning: Military commander, son of Abigail (David's sister), killed by Joab
notes: Amasa, the son of Jether and Abigail (David's sister), was a military commander who served under Absalom and later David, but was killed by Joab.
